chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad narrated from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Sa'dan ibn Muslim from Abu Baseer and others from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
He said: 'From the respect of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is the respect for the Muslim with grey hair (elderly).'

key_terms.ذِي الشَّيْبَةِ: The one with grey hair, referring to an elderly person

ai.seo_question: What is the religious significance of respecting elderly Muslims in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to establish that honoring the elderly Muslim is not merely a social courtesy but a direct manifestation of reverence for Allah (Ijlaal al-Dhari). This concept underscores the theological weight of age in Shia ethics, linking the physical signs of aging to spiritual maturity and divine blessing. It serves as a foundational principle for maintaining intergenerational respect within the Muslim community.
